stack.apis: Public prayer-time calculation API (e.g. Aladhan-style APIs based on Umm al-Qura) — not verified with a URL in this session
stack.payments: Apple In-App Purchase / Google Play Billing, or Moyasar for a web-based subscription

mvp_scope: Paywall/subscription gate (20 SAR/month) via app-store billing
feasibility_validator.monthly_run_cost_sar: ~0-50 SAR (mostly free-tier hosting; app store fees are annual, not monthly)
data_dependencies: A reliable public prayer-time calculation API/data source — none independently verified with a URL in this session
blockers: No evidence anywhere in the candidate's own input of willingness to pay — the candidate itself lists 'Would anyone pay when free apps exist?' as an open, unresolved question, which is the central viability risk, not a build-feasibility one
This is a feature ('show prayer times'), not a documented recurring PAIN with a cost in money/time/lost revenue, so it does not meet the project's own golden-rule bar for a validated opportunity

General knowledge (not verified via search in this session) is that free, high-quality prayer-time apps are widely available in Saudi Arabia/the Gulf, which — if true — would make a 20 SAR/month paywall on a commodity feature very hard to sell; this specific claim is NOT verified with a session URL and is flagged as HYPOTHESIS, not fact
feasibility_validator.summary: From a pure build-feasibility standpoint this is trivially EASY: a solo founder could ship a location-based prayer-time app with push notifications and app-store billing in 1-2 weeks for a few hundred SAR (mainly Apple/Google developer account fees). However, feasibility of BUILDING is not the problem here — the candidate provides zero pain evidence, zero payment evidence, and explicitly flags its own core weakness ('would anyone pay when free apps exist'). This candidate should not be treated as a validated opportunity; it fails the evidence-discipline and golden-rule bars this system is built on, independent of how easy the MVP would be to build. NO RELIABLE EVIDENCE FOUND for willingness to pay.
